title: The Great Outdoors
description: Adds atmospheric Grand Geyser Field Biome! As well as several mobs, plants, decorations and more!
body:
![Logo](https://i.imgur.com/DxOMKq8.png)

Welcome to The Great Outdoors!


REQUIRES GECKOLIB 
https://modrinth.com/mod/geckolib



This mod is a 1.20.1 Forge & 1.21.1 Neoforge mod that currently adds 1 biome; The Grand Geyser Fields!  As well as several mobs, plants, a new woodset

This mod only adds 1 biome at the moment but will eventually add a few more! Each biome is based on locations or biomes that give off unique vibes. The mod is partially educational to teach people about animals, plants, etc in given area.


![Grand Geyser Fields!](https://i.imgur.com/mLuIVnV.png)

The Grand Geyser Fields: 
A atmospheric biome best known for it's geo-thermal features such as geysers, hotsprings, and mud-pots making it one of minecrafts natural wonders!  The biome is abundant with Whitebark Pines, Geothermal features and abundant wildlife and flowers.  Animals added are mostly focused on the Geyser Field biome, though will spawn elsewhere in your world.  Additionally,  new structures have been added; Visitor's Center & Observation Tower which can spawn in several biomes across your world.  A new villager profession called the Park Ranger that has Whitebark Pine Bookshelf as it's work station.


Cross Compatability:

![Screenshot from personal modpack](https://i.imgur.com/mu2cD3h.png)


The Great Outdoor's biomes are compatible with other mods if they have certain mobs, plants, structures etc tagged properly.

The mod should be compatible with most mods, with some issues possibly with world gen tweak mods outside of Tectonic & Terrablender

This mod was tested and is compatible with terrain world gen mods like:
-Tectonic & Terrablender

Known cross compatability with:
- Windswept, Mowzie's Mobs, Everycomp, Enviromental, Verdant Vibes, Barnyard Buddies, Natural Decor Mod and more!

Some recipe cross compatability with:
-Delightful , Farmer's Delight, Adnormal's Delight, Brewen N' Chewen

Mod Dev Note: 

![Puma Hungry](https://i.imgur.com/o5Y0fMy.png)

In real life PLEASE be aware of your surroundings and keep safe distance when hiking especially around wildlife when exploring the wilderness.  Especially for big predators, hazardous terrain or dangerous situations can get you hurt, the world isn't like minecraft. Please don't collect flowers, animals or rocks in protected habitat in real life either. Nature needs to be preserved & protected! :)
